objective: Provide explicit bounded execution of declared project checks with source-bound, redacted local receipts and timeout/cancellation handling.
nonGoals: No implicit project execution from inventory or profiles
No untrusted-code sandbox certification or enforced network isolation
No release/deployment or external-risk command authorization
No changes to s-f CI workflows or other repositories
decisions: Execution runner is an OS process adapter, not a sandbox; external effects remain a separate authority

obligations.description: Execute only explicit profile-declared argument vectors with validated cwd, bounded risk and no shell interpolation
Bounded stdout/stderr and runtime; timeout and cancellation terminate only owned process groups/trees where supported; errors remain errors
Produce versioned local source/profile/command identities and redacted output hashes with honest unverified status
Preserve Linux/Windows support, handle unsupported cleanup mechanisms explicitly and document limits
Do not modify existing profile/inventory behavior or GitHub workflows; retain project-owned authority

structure: src/sf/execution.py: bounded subprocess and read-only Git observations
src/sf/cli.py: explicit sf run command and exit mapping
tests/test_execution.py: isolated synthetic project and process fixtures
impact: Extends CLI with explicitly requested local execution only
Does not execute discovered commands or alter install/upgrade/removal semantics
Adds no provider, credentials or mandatory hosted services

budget.network: No network for inner development; runner does not claim enforcement of declared network=false
budget.execution: Focused local tests, one full suite stable candidate, one PR Actions run when necessary

externalEffects: No merge to main until PR #22 authorized boundary
No auto-merge or merge queue entry
External-risk and mutating commands require later explicit authority
